description:
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Memnite, targeting Phyrexian Walker.
When Memnite dies, Koll triggers, returning Memnite from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Phyrexian Walker.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker, targeting Memnite.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Koll triggers, returning Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Memnite.
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Repeat.
